physical_normalization: l/l0; l0 = first recorded frame index_mcp_object_distance_mm; no future data; do not rebase after gaps
scaler_fitted_on: Input identity fixed; output mean/std fitted on Train only
state_policy: Reset at trial start, missing/invalid input OR target, nonconsecutive frame, nonpositive dt or dt>0.10s
physical_processing: Distance divided by its initial value; no velocity, time normalization, aperture normalization, smoothing or interpolation

models.Function: one scalar current l/l0 -> current aperture in mm; fixed spline lambda=1e-6
models.MLP 5f: 5 l/l0 values oldest-to-current -> Linear(5,32), ReLU, Dropout(.1), Linear(32,32), ReLU, Linear(32,1)
models.LSTM Full: one l/l0 feature per step; causal unidirectional LSTM(1,32), Dropout(.1), Linear(32,1); full chronological prefix, full BPTT; no state transfer across experiments

fairness: Same common five-consecutive-frame targets for fitting losses and main scoring. LSTM consumes all earlier continuous inputs; separate from-start full metrics.
loss: MAE; equal loss weight per experiment; Adam lr=0.001 weight_decay=0.0001
selection: Fixed 400 epochs, last epoch only; Function fit once on Train; Test evaluated only after fitting all models.
